dogecoin.text:
This was in great part due to Elon Musk and various tweets that Tesla might accept payment in Dogecoin.
This year, we too saw a resurgence of memecoin mania, driven, at least in part, by the Solana ecosystem, when BONK was airdropped to those who bought the Saga phone.

I was literally in the room with Vitalik when Dogecoin launched in 2015. At that time, I couldn’t see memecoins as being more than a joke - maybe intended to make blockchain bros laugh at themselves.  Then in 2021-2022, memecoins returned with a vengeance.
